                    阅读11分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><p>事情是这样的。某天深夜我刷到一个 3D 散步模拟器的视频，心想"这玩意儿我也能做啊"，然后打开编辑器就开始写了。三个小时后，我的角色确实在走路——只不过脚不动、身体往前滑，活像个刚喝完三斤白酒的大叔在冰面上漂移。但没关系，修 bug 本来就是开发的一部分。下面我把整个项目从零到跑起来的过程完整记录下来，包括素材怎么找、模型怎么搞、Three.js 怎么搭，以及那些让我怀疑人生的坑。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">一、免费 3D 素材去哪找？别花钱，真没必要</h2>
<p>做 3D 场景最头疼的第一件事就是：模型从哪来？总不能自己建吧？答案是——确实不用自己建，网上免费资源一大把，关键是要找对地方。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">人物模型 + 动画：Mixamo</h3>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6f44f6dbb0934f82877bb0bb230d201e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=pNbbm9S681tGQ8lJ%2BAqpmY%2FrTfM%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/74b4f371f4e74b61b13a15db83af76f8~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=8aEup7qbLfJ7JnVsKvtmDbiGEMU%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这是 Adobe 旗下的免费平台，提供大量带骨骼绑定的人物模型和动作捕捉动画。我的项目用了三个动画：Walking、Running、Idle，全部从 Mixamo 下载，格式选 FBX。</p>
<p><strong>使用要点：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>注册 Adobe 账号即可免费使用</li>
<li>下载时选择 <strong>FBX for Unity (.fbx)</strong> 格式，Three.js 的 FBXLoader 能直接读</li>
<li>同一个角色下载多个动画时，骨骼结构必须一致（用同一个 T-Pose 角色），否则动画切换时会"抽风"</li>
<li>建议先下载一个带动画的完整模型作为基础 mesh，再单独下载其他动画的 FBX 文件只取动画数据</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">场景装饰模型：免费网站大盘点</h3>
<p>场景里的树、花、城堡这些装饰物，全是从免费网站上薅的。下面把我常用的网站列出来，附上链接，按推荐程度排序：</p>
<p><strong>1. Sketchfab</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fsketchfab.com" target="_blank" title="https://sketchfab.com" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">sketchfab.com</a></p>
<p>3D 模型的"GitHub"，模型数量最多、质量也最高。筛选条件选 <code>Downloadable + Free</code>，格式选 glTF/GLB。下载后直接丢进 <code>public/models/</code> 目录就能用。我的樱树、枫树、松树、雪人、玫瑰花、城堡全是从这找的。唯一缺点是免费模型里偶尔会混入低质量的，需要自己筛一下。</p>
<p><strong>2. Poly Pizza</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fpoly.pizza" target="_blank" title="https://poly.pizza" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">poly.pizza</a></p>
<p>低多边形（Low Poly）风格模型的天堂！全部免费，无需注册即可下载，格式支持 GLB 和 OBJ。如果你做的是 Low Poly 风格的场景，这个网站比 Sketchfab 更好用——模型风格统一，不会出现一个写实树旁边一个卡通树的尴尬。我的项目里部分装饰模型就是从这拿的。</p>
<p><strong>3. Quaternius</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fquaternius.com" target="_blank" title="https://quaternius.com" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">quaternius.com</a></p>
<p>又一个 Low Poly 免费素材站，特点是模型分类非常清晰（人物、动物、植物、建筑、道具……），而且所有模型都是 CC0 协议（公共领域），随便用，不用署名。模型质量稳定，风格偏简约可爱。</p>
<p><strong>4. Kenney</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kenney.nl%2Fassets" target="_blank" title="https://www.kenney.nl/assets" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">kenney.nl/assets</a></p>
<p>游戏开发界的"免费素材之王"。不仅有 3D 模型，还有贴图、音效、UI 素材，全部 CC0 协议。3D 模型以 Low Poly 为主，适合做游戏原型和独立项目。网站界面简洁，下载方便，一个 ZIP 包里包含所有格式（FBX、OBJ、GLB 都有）。</p>
<p><strong>5. CGTrader</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cgtrader.com" target="_blank" title="https://www.cgtrader.com" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">cgtrader.com</a></p>
<p>专业级 3D 模型市场，但筛选 <code>Free</code> 标签后能找到不少高质量免费模型。格式选择多（FBX、OBJ、GLB 等），质量普遍比 Sketchfab 高，但免费数量少一些。适合找那种"一个模型撑起整个场景"的重点物件（比如我的城堡模型就是在这找到的）。</p>
<p><strong>6. Free3D</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Ffree3d.com" target="_blank" title="https://free3d.com" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">free3d.com</a></p>
<p>名字就叫 Free3D。模型种类多，格式全，但界面比较老，需要花点时间翻找。适合找一些 Sketchfab 上没有的冷门模型。</p>
<p><strong>7. Tripo AI</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tripo3d.ai" target="_blank" title="https://www.tripo3d.ai" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">tripo3d.ai</a></p>
<p>如果以上网站都找不到想要的，可以用 AI 生成。输入文字描述就能生成 3D 模型，免费额度够用。项目里也预留了 Meshy AI 的接口（<code>modelGenerator.ts</code>），原理一样：调 API 提交生成任务 → 轮询等结果 → 拿到 GLB 模型 URL。</p>
<p><strong>8. Meshy AI</strong> —— <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.meshy.ai" target="_blank" title="https://www.meshy.ai" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">meshy.ai</a></p>
<p>和 Tripo 类似的 AI 3D 生成工具，文字/图片转 3D 模型。免费用户每月有一定生成额度，生成的模型可以直接导出 GLB 格式。</p>
<p><strong>选站建议：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>要 Low Poly 风格 → Poly Pizza / Quaternius / Kenney</li>
<li>要写实风格 → Sketchfab / CGTrader</li>
<li>要特定物件找不到 → Free3D / CGTrader</li>
<li>以上都没有 → Tripo AI / Meshy AI 自己生成</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>我的素材清单：</strong></p>






































































<table><thead><tr><th>文件</th><th>用途</th><th>来源</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Walking.fbx</td><td>行走动画</td><td>Mixamo</td></tr><tr><td>Running.fbx</td><td>跑步动画</td><td>Mixamo</td></tr><tr><td>Idle.fbx</td><td>待机动画</td><td>Mixamo</td></tr><tr><td>樱树.glb</td><td>春天场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>春天的树.glb</td><td>春/夏场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>枫树.glb</td><td>秋天场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>松树.glb</td><td>冬天/夜晚</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>花.glb</td><td>春/夏装饰</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>玫瑰花.glb</td><td>浪漫场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>城堡.glb</td><td>浪漫场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>雪人.glb</td><td>冬天场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr><tr><td>高楼大厦.glb</td><td>城市场景</td><td>Sketchfab</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>一个省钱小技巧：</strong> 同一类模型只下载一个，然后通过代码随机缩放、旋转、摆放，视觉上就能产生"很多不同树"的效果。我的春天场景 30 棵樱树其实都是同一个模型，只是大小和角度不同。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">二、Three.js 场景搭建：从一块绿地板开始</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/32ea59c469694570b6f2e9bd24289c84~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=8ZXOK3GSx%2Be%2BqD1IfUe7oFbmerY%3D" alt="chrome-capture-2026-05-22.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>技术栈选型很简单：Vue 3 + Three.js + Vite + TypeScript。Vue 负责 UI 面板，Three.js 负责 3D 渲染，各司其职。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">核心架构</h3>
<p>整个 3D 部分拆成了几个类，各管一摊：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-sql" lang="sql">SceneManager（总管）
  ├── <span class="hljs-type">Character</span>（角色：加载模型、切换动画）
  ├── Environment（环境：天空、地面、灯光、雾气）
  ├── ParticleSystem（粒子：雪花、落叶、花瓣、萤火虫）
  └── Path（路径：脚下的路和地面纹理滚动）
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">渲染器初始化</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">WebGLRenderer</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">antialias</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> })
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>.<span class="hljs-property">shadowMap</span>.<span class="hljs-property">enabled</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>.<span class="hljs-property">shadowMap</span>.<span class="hljs-property">type</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PCFSoftShadowMap</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>.<span class="hljs-property">toneMapping</span> = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ACESFilmicToneMapping</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">renderer</span>.<span class="hljs-property">toneMappingExposure</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1.0</span>
</code></pre>
<p>几个关键配置：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>antialias: true</code> —— 抗锯齿，不然模型边缘全是毛刺</li>
<li><code>PCFSoftShadowMap</code> —— 柔和阴影，比默认的 BasicShadowMap 好看很多</li>
<li><code>ACESFilmicToneMapping</code> —— 电影级色调映射，让画面更有质感，不会过曝</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">地面滚动的"障眼法"</h3>
<p>这是个有意思的技巧。角色其实并没有真的在场景中"走很远"——地面是跟着角色移动的，但纹理的 UV offset 在不断偏移，制造出"地面在脚下流过"的视觉效果。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">updateGroundScroll</span>(<span class="hljs-params">pathMesh: THREE.Mesh, ground: THREE.Mesh | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, charZ: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> uvOffset = charZ * <span class="hljs-number">0.05</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pathMat = pathMesh.<span class="hljs-property">material</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MeshStandardMaterial</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (pathMat.<span class="hljs-property">map</span>) {
    pathMat.<span class="hljs-property">map</span>.<span class="hljs-property">offset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> = uvOffset
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ground) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> groundMat = ground.<span class="hljs-property">material</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MeshStandardMaterial</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (groundMat.<span class="hljs-property">map</span>) {
      groundMat.<span class="hljs-property">map</span>.<span class="hljs-property">offset</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> = uvOffset
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>这样做的好处是：地面和路径的几何体始终跟着角色走，不需要无限长的地面，但视觉上看起来角色一直在往前走。装饰物（树、花等）则是固定在场景中的，角色走过就留在身后——这种"近处动、远处不动"的组合，比纯滚动更有沉浸感。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">粒子系统：从雪花到萤火虫</h3>
<p>粒子系统支持五种效果：雪花、落叶、沙尘、萤火虫、花瓣。核心思路一样——用 <code>THREE.Points</code> + <code>BufferGeometry</code>，每帧更新位置。</p>
<p>不同粒子的区别在于运动方向和视觉参数：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">switch</span> (config.<span class="hljs-property">type</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'snow'</span>:     <span class="hljs-comment">// 缓慢下落 + 轻微水平漂移</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'leaves'</span>:   <span class="hljs-comment">// 下落 + 水平飘动 + 前进方向</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'sand'</span>:     <span class="hljs-comment">// 水平方向为主（沙漠风暴感）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'fireflies'</span>: <span class="hljs-comment">// 随机缓慢漂浮 + 加法混合（发光感）</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">case</span> <span class="hljs-string">'petals'</span>:   <span class="hljs-comment">// 类似落叶但更轻柔</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>萤火虫效果有个特殊处理：使用 <code>AdditiveBlending</code>（加法混合），让粒子叠加时更亮，模拟发光效果。这是做夜间场景氛围的关键。</p>
<p>还有一个细节：粒子超出角色周围 20 单位范围后会被"回收"并重新生成在角色附近，这样不管角色走多远，粒子始终围绕在身边。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">场景过渡动画</h3>
<p>切换场景时不是硬切，而是用 smoothstep 缓动函数做 2 秒的颜色渐变：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> eased = t * t * (<span class="hljs-number">3</span> - <span class="hljs-number">2</span> * t) <span class="hljs-comment">// smoothstep</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scene</span>.<span class="hljs-property">background</span> = startBg.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">lerp</span>(targetBg, eased)
</code></pre>
<p>天空颜色、地面颜色、环境光、雾气参数全部同步插值，所以从春天切到冬天时，你能看到绿色慢慢变白、粉色天空渐变成冷蓝色，整个过程很丝滑。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-9">三、角色动画：从"冰面漂移"到正常走路</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/fc5cb95b82fe4bdca47bc14ee51e6522~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=5FFC5tjrKMaK3c38kXN2ljBn1ZE%3D" alt="chrome-capture-2026-05-22 (1).gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这是整个项目踩坑最多的部分。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">动画加载</h3>
<p>Mixamo 下载的 FBX 文件里，每个文件都包含完整的模型 + 一个动画。我的做法是：用 Walking.fbx 作为基础模型（取 mesh），然后从 Running.fbx 和 Idle.fbx 里只提取动画数据：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">load</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">walkUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">runUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">idleUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">void</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> loader = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FBXLoader</span>()
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> walkModel = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">loadFBX</span>(loader, walkUrl)
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span> = walkModel  <span class="hljs-comment">// 用 walk 模型作为基础 mesh</span>

  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mixer</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">AnimationMixer</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 从 walk 模型取行走动画</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (walkModel.<span class="hljs-property">animations</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> clip = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stripRootPosition</span>(walkModel.<span class="hljs-property">animations</span>[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>])
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">walkAction</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mixer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clipAction</span>(clip)
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 从 run 模型只取跑步动画</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> runModel = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">loadFBX</span>(loader, runUrl)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (runModel.<span class="hljs-property">animations</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> clip = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stripRootPosition</span>(runModel.<span class="hljs-property">animations</span>[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>])
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">runAction</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mixer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clipAction</span>(clip)
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// idle 同理...</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">第一个坑：角色在场景里"漂移"</h3>
<p>加载完动画后，角色确实在走了，但整个人在场景里不断往前滑——这就是开头说的"冰面漂移"。</p>
<p>原因：Mixamo 的动画数据里包含了根骨骼（Root/Hips）的位移信息。动画播放时，角色的根节点会按照动画里的位移数据移动，而我的代码也在移动角色的 position，两者叠加就导致角色"跑得比预期快"。</p>
<p>解决方法：<code>stripRootPosition</code>——在应用动画之前，把根骨骼的位移轨道过滤掉：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stripRootPosition</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">clip</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">AnimationClip</span>): <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">AnimationClip</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> stripped = clip.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>()
  stripped.<span class="hljs-property">tracks</span> = stripped.<span class="hljs-property">tracks</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">track</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> name = track.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toLowerCase</span>()
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isPosition = name.<span class="hljs-title function_">endsWith</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.position'</span>) || name.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'position'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> isRoot = !name.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.'</span>) || name.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'hips'</span>) || name.<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'root'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> !(isPosition &amp;&amp; isRoot)  <span class="hljs-comment">// 过滤掉根骨骼的位移</span>
  })
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> stripped
}
</code></pre>
<p>只保留旋转轨道，位移由代码控制。这样角色就在原地踏步，位置完全由我的键盘输入决定。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">第二个坑：动画切换时角色"抽搐"</h3>
<p>直接从一个动画切到另一个时，角色会突然跳到新姿势，看起来像触电。</p>
<p>解决方法：<code>crossFadeTo</code>——使用 Three.js 的动画交叉淡入淡出：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">crossFadeTo</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">newAction</span>: <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">AnimationAction</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentAction</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentAction</span> = newAction
    newAction.<span class="hljs-title function_">play</span>()
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> oldAction = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentAction</span>
  newAction.<span class="hljs-title function_">reset</span>()
  newAction.<span class="hljs-title function_">setLoop</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">LoopRepeat</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Infinity</span>)
  newAction.<span class="hljs-title function_">play</span>()
  oldAction.<span class="hljs-title function_">crossFadeTo</span>(newAction, duration, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>)  <span class="hljs-comment">// 0.3秒过渡</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentAction</span> = newAction
}
</code></pre>
<p>0.3 秒的过渡时间，从走到跑、从跑到停，都很自然。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">第三个坑：角色走路没有上下起伏</h3>
<p>过滤掉根骨骼位移后，角色走路时完全没有上下弹动，看起来像在滑旱冰。</p>
<p>解决方法：手动加一个正弦波的垂直偏移（bob）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">delta</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">isMoving</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mixer</span>?.<span class="hljs-title function_">update</span>(delta)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isMoving &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bobAmplitude</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> speed = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">'run'</span> ? <span class="hljs-number">12</span> : <span class="hljs-number">7</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bobPhase</span> += delta * speed
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bob = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abs</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bobPhase</span>)) * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">bobAmplitude</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> += bob
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>走路时振幅 0.04，跑步时 0.08，频率也更快。<code>Math.abs(Math.sin(...))</code> 让弹动始终向上，模拟脚掌着地时的反作用力。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">模型缩放与对齐</h3>
<p>Mixamo 模型的大小各不相同，需要统一缩放到约 1.8 单位高（模拟人类身高），并确保脚底对齐地面 y=0：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> box = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Box3</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">setFromObject</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> size = box.<span class="hljs-title function_">getSize</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Vector3</span>())
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scale = <span class="hljs-number">1.8</span> / size.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">scale</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">set</span>(scale, scale, scale)

<span class="hljs-comment">// 重新计算包围盒，把脚底对齐到 y=0</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> newBox = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Box3</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">setFromObject</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>)
<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">mesh</span>.<span class="hljs-property">position</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> = -newBox.<span class="hljs-property">min</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-15">四、AI 加持：用 Claude 生成场景配置</h2>
<p>项目最酷的部分——用户输入一段文字描述（比如"樱花飘落的夜晚"），Claude API 会生成对应的场景配置 JSON，然后直接渲染出来。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">实现原理</h3>
<ol>
<li>用户输入场景描述</li>
<li>调用 Claude API，system prompt 里定义了场景配置的 JSON Schema</li>
<li>Claude 返回一个符合接口的 JSON 对象</li>
<li>解析 JSON，应用到场景中</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">SYSTEM_PROMPT</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`You are a scene configuration generator for a 3D walking simulation.
Given a user's scene description, generate a JSON configuration object.

The JSON must follow this exact TypeScript interface:
{
  ground: { color: string, roughness: number },
  sky: { color: string, fogColor: string, fogNear: number, fogFar: number },
  ambientLight: { color: string, intensity: number },
  directionalLight: { color: string, intensity: number, position: [number, number, number] },
  particles: { type: "snow" | "leaves" | "sand" | "fireflies" | "none", ... } | null,
  decorations: { prompt: string, count: number, side: "left" | "right" | "both" }[]
}`</span>
</code></pre>
<p>关键技巧：system prompt 里把接口定义得非常精确，包括枚举值（<code>"snow" | "leaves" | ...</code>），这样 Claude 返回的 JSON 几乎不需要后处理就能直接用。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">JSON 提取的容错处理</h3>
<p>Claude 有时候会在 JSON 外面包一层 markdown 代码块（<code>```json ... ```</code>），所以需要正则提取：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> jsonMatch = text.<span class="hljs-title function_">match</span>(<span class="hljs-regexp">/\{[\s\S]*\}/</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!jsonMatch) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Failed to parse scene configuration from AI response'</span>)
}
<span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(jsonMatch[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SceneConfig</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-18">城市场景的特殊处理</h3>
<p>城市场景没有用 GLB 模型，而是用代码程序化生成建筑：随机高度的 BoxGeometry + 窗户发光贴片 + 路灯点光源。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f75beba303e84ac39d0e82365d52a1ea~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=oIdmMXOU8tGm8Jodq2WNeSdEg7Q%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 程序化生成建筑</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; buildingConfig.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>; i++) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> width = <span class="hljs-number">2</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">4</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> height = <span class="hljs-number">8</span> + <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * <span class="hljs-number">25</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> geo = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">BoxGeometry</span>(width, height, depth)
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...窗户是小的 PlaneGeometry，带 emissive 材质</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>窗户用 <code>MeshStandardMaterial</code> 的 <code>emissive</code> 属性实现自发光，40% 的窗户随机不亮，模拟真实城市里有的房间关灯了的效果。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-19">模型缓存</h3>
<p>同一个 GLB 文件可能被实例化多次（比如 30 棵樱树），每次都重新加载太浪费。用 <code>Map</code> 做了个简单的缓存：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> modelCache = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span>&gt;()

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">loadGLBModel</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-variable constant_">THREE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Group</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (modelCache.<span class="hljs-title function_">has</span>(url)) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> modelCache.<span class="hljs-title function_">get</span>(url)!.<span class="hljs-title function_">clone</span>()  <span class="hljs-comment">// 缓存命中，直接 clone</span>
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...加载并缓存</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>clone()</code> 比 <code>load()</code> 快几个数量级，30 棵树只加载一次模型文件。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-20">最后</h2>
<p>这个项目从"一块绿地板上一个不会动的方块人"到"7 种场景自由切换 + AI 生成 + 粒子特效"，大概花了半天时间。最耗时的不是写代码，而是找素材和调参数——天空颜色差一点感觉就完全不对，雾的远近对氛围影响巨大。</p>
<p>技术栈总结：Vue 3 + Three.js + Vite + TypeScript，模型来源 Mixamo + Sketchfab，AI 场景生成用 Claude API。整个项目没有花一分钱在素材上，免费资源完全够用。</p>
<p>如果你也想做类似的项目，记住三点：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>先让角色能动起来</strong>，其他都是锦上添花</li>
<li><strong>Mixamo 的动画一定要 stripRootPosition</strong>，不然你会花两小时调试"为什么角色在漂移"</li>
<li><strong>粒子效果是氛围的灵魂</strong>，没有雪花的冬天和没有花瓣的春天，就是一坨绿色/白色方块</li>
</ol>

<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/fbe0e94f0e3d44fdb45be3e161ed14af~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg6L-Y5pyJ5aSa5LmF5ou_6YCA5LyR6YeR:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786151659&amp;x-signature=%2F0arsqTbRBl8k2vn6F7A%2FDJwBwA%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
